pair.title: Sparky Smart P1 Meter
pair.subtitle: Enter the details of your Sparky P1 meter here.
pair.intro_subtitle: Sparkys on your network may appear in the next step. You can also add one manually by entering its IP address.
pair.firmware_requirement: We only support Sparkys with firmware 95 or higher (with the Sparky API enabled).
pair.manual_subtitle: If your Sparky was not listed above, enter its name and IP address below. The Sparky must have the API enabled (firmware 95 or higher).
pair.subtitle_firmware_update: Confirm that you have installed the latest firmware version of Sparky.
pair.update_instructions: Follow these instructions to check your Sparky Firmware.
pair.step2: Open the Sparky app on your mobile or tablet.
pair.step4: Ensure your Sparky is running on firmware version 95 or higher before you continue.
pair.note: If your Sparky is not running the latest version of the Firmware, it will be updated within 24 hours after a fresh installation. If that is not the case, please contact our customer service.
pair.error_no_sparky: No Sparky found at this address. Check the IP and that the Sparky API is enabled (firmware 95 or higher).
pair.discover_subtitle: Sparkys on your network will appear below. Only devices with firmware 95 or higher are shown.
pair.discover_searching: Searching for Sparkys on your network…
pair.discover_none: No Sparkys found on your network.
pair.discover_none_hint: You can add one manually by IP address.
